notes: Rule 11: a second witness, «عبد الله بن إبراهيم بن قارظ», repeats the saying inside the story with his own «أشهد أني سمعت أبا هريرة» isnad; it is not written as a route. Whether it is a second isnad or only a scene is for the ruling.
«وأبي عبد الله الأغر» : the attached «و» is dropped; «مولى الجهنيين» is an epithet, left out.
